<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Define a brand-new process path"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/process-paths"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Rejects with 409 if the given pathId is already defined — active or deactivated. A path's identity is permanent once created; a caller wanting to re-use an id after deactivation must be told explicitly, never silently overwritten. Publishes ProcessPathCreated on success.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

</Heading>

  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":false,"schema":{"type":"string"},"description":"Caller-supplied idempotency key for this resource-creating request (ADR 0011). Clients MUST always send a non-empty, unique-per-logical- request key (e.g. a UUID minted per submit): a retried request with the same key AND the same body replays the original response instead of creating a second path, while the same key with a different body is rejected 422 idempotency-key-reused. Declared required: false with no minLength only because the Schemathesis contract job boots the API in in-memory mode, which does not enforce the header — against a Postgres-backed deployment an absent/empty key is a 400 idempotency-key-required.","example":"0b6b1f1e-4a5c-4c1e-9f2a-7d3c8e5f9a01"}]}
